observations: Photo 0: three black vinyl/leather salon chairs with hydraulic pumps and square chrome bases, standing outdoors among other used furniture/junk.
Photo 1: close-up of two of the same square-base chairs, same outdoor/used-goods yard, Jiji watermark 'MAKUO IGBOKWE' visible.
Photo 2: a single chair of a different design (rounded headrest, chrome-trimmed armrests, round pedestal base), set against a cluttered background with other furniture and debris.
Photo 3: a single chair of yet another design (armrests with oval cut-out, round base), background shows plastic-wrapped stacked chairs suggesting a showroom or different location than photos 0-1.
Visible wear: scuffed leather, dusty/dirty bases, worn padding corners in several photos.
No brand or model text is legible on any chair or base in any photo.

claims.evidence: Photos show chairs of at least three distinct designs; no indication which exact chair(s) are included in the sale.
No video or photo shows hydraulic lift, recline, swivel, or footrest in motion; only static shots.

risks.risk: Hydraulic pump may be slow, leaking, or not holding height
risks.proof: Short video showing the chair being pumped up and down and staying at height
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional hydraulic (lowest working-condition tier)

risks.risk: Recline/tilt and locking mechanism may be broken or missing
risks.proof: Video clip showing seatback reclining and locking in at least two positions

risks.risk: Base or legs may be rusted, cracked, or welded poorly (common in used salon stock)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each chair's base and leg joints in good light
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic-only, structural risk discounted

risks.risk: Photos show different chair models/styles; buyer may not receive the exact chair pictured
risks.proof: Seller confirms, with one photo per unit for sale, exactly which chairs/quantity are being sold in this listing
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lowest-spec chair style shown (photo 0/1 simple square-arm design)

risks.risk: Leather/vinyl tears or seat foam collapse not visible in current angles
risks.proof: Close-up of seat cushion and backrest surface, including underside seams
risks.if_unproven: priced as visibly worn, moderate cosmetic wear

proof_requests: Video of hydraulic pump raising/lowering each chair
Video of backrest reclining and locking
Clear photo confirming exactly which chair(s)/how many are included in this sale, matching a single consistent style
Close-up photos of base welds and legs for rust/cracks
Close-up of seat and backrest surface for tears or foam damage
response.reason: The item type (used hydraulic salon/barber chair) is clear enough to price at worst case given visible wear and unproven functional claims, but the mismatched chair designs across photos and lack of any motion proof mean it must be priced as the lowest-spec, unverified-condition unit until the seller clarifies exact unit and demonstrates function.
